title: DECISION (user): must dice-consuming mutation tools bind seeded roll evidence deterministically?
description: Surfaced by eshyra-o9bd.19.5.13 triage. record_death_save and restore_usage accept a caller-supplied natural die result (range-checked only). Today that result is model-audited: the mechanics auditor (turnAuditor.ts ~L158-167) rejects a turn whose hand-written roll contradicts tool output. Level-up HP rolls instead bind deterministic evidence (validateDiceRollEvidence). ADR 0020 section 3 makes random-number generation a deterministic responsibility. Options: (A) keep auditor-checked binding (current; inventory states the trust boundary truthfully); (B) require these tools to consume a roll-tool result id/evidence from the same turn and refuse otherwise (sibling search over every tool taking a natural/roll input). This is an architectural/authority decision reserved for the user; no implementation until decided.
notes:
DECISION (user, 2026-11-07): engine rolls by default; the DM may still supply its own result, following the start_effect item-duration precedent (omit = engine rolls; supplied = recorded override with basis dm-adjudicated|house-rule, reason, ruleId?). The engine roll must honor modifiers only the DM knows (saveBonus/bonusSources; advantage/disadvantage). Pre-freeze. Implementation: eshyra-o9bd.19.5.15.
CORRECTION: the implementation bead is eshyra-o9bd.19.5.16, not .19.5.15.
close_reason: Decided by the user 2026-11-07 (see notes): engine-rolled by default with a recorded DM override. Implementation owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.5.16.
